decision: fix(oracle): make commit() idempotent — skip duplicate proposals
key_insight: fix(oracle): make commit() idempotent — skip duplicate proposals
outcome:
Fixes #49.

## Problem

`quorum commit <id>` had no idempotency guard. Calling it twice on the same proposal (or re-staging the same proposal UUID) wrote a second entry to `.chronicle/committed/` with a fresh UUID and timestamp. The vector index would then contain the same content twice, causing `oracle.query()` to return duplicate evidence and skewing Jury/Council scoring.
